description: This source file defines the EmployeeAttachmentService class, which provides methods to manage employee attachments such as retrieving, saving, and deleting attachments in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It interacts with the EmployeeAttachmentDao for database operations and includes role-based access control via a trait.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee attachment operations such as retrieval, saving, and deletion, with role-based access control.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeAttachmentDao instance used for database operations related to employee attachments.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Fetches a list of attachments for a given employee number and screen.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee attachment by employee number and attachment ID, with optional screen parameter.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed information for a specific employee attachment.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeAttachment entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes specified employee attachments based on IDs.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves an employee attachment if the current user has access rights based on role or self-identifier.
